notes:
Blast Yard 0.42

MONSTERS
- Every monster has its own personality now. Blobs are slower and mostly wander; Chasers are the real hunters; Mimics ambush in short bursts; Ghosts and Hoppers drift your way less often.
- Monsters have to see you (straight line, not through blocks) or, for Chasers and Mimics, hear you close by.
- A monster that spots you shows a "!" and stops for a moment before it comes for you - your warning.
- They get bored: after a few seconds of chasing they show a "?" and leave you alone for a while.
- At most 2 monsters chase you at once - the rest keep wandering. Bosses are unchanged.
- Smart monsters (Chasers, Mimics) step out of a bomb's blast line - lure the dumb ones in instead.

SAFER UPDATES
- Your save is copied every time a new version starts, so an update can never cost you your progress.

Your profile and progress are kept.
